2010.title: Part B 图表作文：手机用户量增长情况对比
2010.apply_en:
The bar chart tracks how mobile-phone subscriptions in developing and developed countries changed over the period. Both rose, but Subscriptions in developing countries climbed from 0.5 billion to 4 billion while those in developed countries only went from 0.7 billion to 1 billion. From 2000 to 2008, Subscriptions in developing countries rose from 0.5 billion to 4 billion, a steady climb. By 2008, Subscriptions in developing countries had more than doubled, reaching 4 billion.

The trend in the chart is closely tied to how people live and spend today. As household incomes have grown, mobile services has moved from a luxury to an everyday necessity. More importantly, mobile services now serves a practical need rather than a passing fashion. Online platforms and mobile payment have cut the time and cost of getting mobile services.

If the trend in the chart is to continue, more than one side has to act. Each of them has a different job to do, and none can do it alone. Government can fund public facilities so that mobile services is not limited to those who can pay.
2010.apply_cn:
该柱状图记录了这一时期发展中国家与发达国家的手机订阅量的变化。两者都在上升，但发展中国家的订阅量由5亿升至40亿，而发达国家同期的订阅量仅从7亿升到10亿。自2000年至2008年，发展中国家的订阅量由5亿稳步升至40亿。到2008年时，发展中国家的订阅量已经翻了一倍多，达到40亿。

图中的变化与人们当下的生活和消费方式密切相关。随着家庭收入提高，手机服务已从奢侈品变成日常必需品。更重要的是，手机服务现在满足的是实际需要，而不是一时风尚。线上平台和移动支付降低了获得手机服务的时间和成本。

图中的趋势若要延续，就需要多方一起行动。各方要做的事不同，单靠任何一方都做不到。政府可以投入公共设施，让手机服务不只属于付得起钱的人。
tips: 柱状图（bar）、两事物同向但快慢不同 → 用 **② 同向不同速**骨架（Both rose, but … climbed … while … only went from …）。
题眼是「速度不同」：骨架的 while 已经点出，句池再补一句强调增速（a steady climb / had more than doubled）。
第二段套**经济类**：归因落在「收入增长 → 手机从奢侈品变成必需品」，句池挑「收入」「观念」两句最贴。
数据只需首末两年（2000 / 2008），不必逐年罗列；单位是 billion subscriptions。

2011.title: Part B 图表作文：汽车品牌市场份额变化
2011.apply_en:
The bar chart tracks how the market shares of Chinese, Japanese and American auto brands changed from the earlier period to the later period. Chinese brands climbed from a modest share to the leading position, while American brands fell from a small share to a slightly larger share. By the later period, Chinese brands had more than doubled, reaching the leading position.

The trend in the chart is closely tied to how people live and spend today. As household incomes have grown, domestic auto brands has moved from a luxury to an everyday necessity. More importantly, domestic auto brands now serves a practical need rather than a passing fashion. Online platforms and mobile payment have cut the time and cost of getting domestic auto brands.

Schools can build domestic auto brands into daily routines instead of treating it as an extra. Families matter most: children copy what adults do far more than what they are told. Companies can make domestic auto brands cheaper and easier to use, so that it reaches more people.
2011.apply_cn:
该柱状图记录了前一时期到后一时期期间中国、日本与美国汽车品牌的市场份额的变化。国产品牌由一个不大的份额升至领先地位，而美系品牌由一个较小的份额降至略大的份额。到后一时期时，国产品牌已经翻了一倍多，达到领先地位。

图中的变化与人们当下的生活和消费方式密切相关。随着家庭收入提高，国产汽车品牌已从奢侈品变成日常必需品。更重要的是，国产汽车品牌现在满足的是实际需要，而不是一时风尚。线上平台和移动支付降低了获得国产汽车品牌的时间和成本。

学校可以把国产汽车品牌纳入日常安排，而不是当成额外任务。家庭最关键：孩子模仿大人怎么做，远多于听大人怎么说。企业可以把国产汽车品牌做得更便宜、更好用，让它覆盖更多人。
tips: 柱状图、三事物有升有降 → 用 **③ 一升一降**骨架（… climbed …, while … fell …）。
第三项（美系持平）用句池的 held steady at around 单列，形成「升—降—平」三层结构，这是本题最容易漏的层次。
第二段套**经济类**：双因 = 技术差距缩小 + 营销策略变化。
份额变化用 **percentage points（百分点）**，不要与 percent 混用。

2012.title: Part B 图表作文：某公司员工工作满意度调查
2012.apply_en:
The table chart shows how job satisfaction across the age groups is distributed among the categories. The group over 50 takes the largest share, at 40%. By contrast, employees aged 40 or younger and the remaining respondents account for only 16.7% and a still smaller share. The group over 50 alone accounts for 40% of the total.

The change in the chart reflects a broader shift in how people live and work. Once basic needs are met, people care more about how they spend their time. Longer working hours have made people value the time they can call their own. Rising incomes have turned what used to be a luxury into an ordinary purchase. Young people change jobs far more often than their parents did, so loyalty works differently.

If the trend in the chart is to continue, more than one side has to act. Each of them has a different job to do, and none can do it alone. Government can fund public facilities so that job satisfaction is not limited to those who can pay.
2012.apply_cn:
该表格图显示各年龄段的工作满意度在各类别之间的分布情况。50岁以上群体占比最高，为40%。相比之下，40岁及以下员工和其余受访者仅占16.7%和更小的比例。50岁以上群体一项就占了总量的40%。

图中的变化反映了人们生活和工作方式的更大转变。基本需求满足之后，人们更在意自己的时间怎么花。更长的工作时间让人们更看重属于自己的时间。收入提高把过去的奢侈品变成了日常消费。年轻人换工作比父辈频繁得多，「忠诚」的含义已经不同。

图中的趋势若要延续，就需要多方一起行动。各方要做的事不同，单靠任何一方都做不到。政府可以投入公共设施，让工作满意度不只属于付得起钱的人。
tips: 先看清图型：题干给的是**表格（table）** → 首句把 {{chart}} 填成 table（This table shows how…），这是本题最容易失分的地方。
数据是「分组比高低」而不是时间变化 → 用**静态骨架**（largest share / come next / By contrast）。
41–50 岁组「无人满意 + 64% 不满」是关键对比，务必写出。
第二段改套**社会·职场·生活类**（句池里带「2012」的那两句），归因落点写「职业平台期 / 期望与回报不匹配」。

2013.title: Part B 大作文：大学生兼职比例柱状图
2013.apply_en:
The bar chart tracks the proportion of college students taking part-time jobs from the first year to the final year. It rose from 67.77% to 88.24% without a single fall. From the first year to the final year, The rate rose from 67.77% to 88.24%, a steady climb. Over the same period, the proportion in the graduation year fell from 83.7% to 88.24%, a clear decline.

Behind the numbers in the chart lies a change in how students spend their time. Habits built at this stage shape how young people take responsibility later. Part-time jobs is one of the clearest examples. Part-time jobs teaches students to plan their own time rather than wait to be told. On the other hand, too much of it can crowd out sleep and real conversation.

Each of them has a different job to do, and none can do it alone. Government can fund public facilities so that part-time jobs is not limited to those who can pay. Schools can build part-time jobs into daily routines instead of treating it as an extra.
2013.apply_cn:
该柱状图记录了大学生兼职比例从大一到大四的变化。它由67.77%一路升至88.24%，中途没有回落。自大一至大四，这一比例由67.77%稳步升至88.24%。同一时期，毕业当年的比例由83.7%降至88.24%，降幅明显。

数字背后，是学生时间安排方式的变化。这个阶段养成的习惯，会影响他们日后承担责任的方式。兼职就是最清楚的例子之一。兼职让学生学会自己安排时间，而不是等人安排。另一方面，过度投入会挤占睡眠和真实交流的时间。

各方要做的事不同，单靠任何一方都做不到。政府可以投入公共设施，让兼职不只属于付得起钱的人。学校可以把兼职纳入日常安排，而不是当成额外任务。
tips: 单事物逐年上升 → 用 **① 单线上升**骨架（It rose from … to … without a single fall），不要硬凑对比句。
题眼是「毕业年增幅最大」：句池补一句点出加速。
第二段套**校园类**：落点写「就业竞争 + 职业准备」。
数字照抄原图（67.77% / 88.24%），百分比保留两位小数。

2014.title: Part B 大作文：城市与乡村人口的变化
2014.apply_en:
The bar chart tracks how the urban and rural population changed from 1990 to 2010. The urban population climbed from 300 million to 670 million, while the rural population fell from 820 million to 680 million. From 1990 to 2010, The urban population rose from 300 million to 670 million, a steady climb. Over the same period, the rural population fell from 820 million to 680 million, a clear decline.

The trend in the chart is closely tied to how people live and spend today. As household incomes have grown, urbanization has moved from a luxury to an everyday necessity. More importantly, urbanization now serves a practical need rather than a passing fashion. Online platforms and mobile payment have cut the time and cost of getting urbanization.

Government can fund public facilities so that urbanization is not limited to those who can pay. Schools can build urbanization into daily routines instead of treating it as an extra. Families matter most: children copy what adults do far more than what they are told. Clear rules and steady funding matter more than one-off campaigns.

该柱状图记录了1990年到2010年期间城镇与农村人口的变化。城镇人口由3亿升至6.7亿，而农村人口由8.2亿降至6.8亿。自1990年至2010年，城镇人口由3亿稳步升至6.7亿。同一时期，农村人口由8.2亿降至6.8亿，降幅明显。

图中的变化与人们当下的生活和消费方式密切相关。随着家庭收入提高，城镇化已从奢侈品变成日常必需品。更重要的是，城镇化现在满足的是实际需要，而不是一时风尚。线上平台和移动支付降低了获得城镇化的时间和成本。

政府可以投入公共设施，让城镇化不只属于付得起钱的人。学校可以把城镇化纳入日常安排，而不是当成额外任务。家庭最关键：孩子模仿大人怎么做，远多于听大人怎么说。明确的规则和持续的投入，比一次性活动更重要。

2016.title: Part B 大作文：高校学生旅游目的调查饼图
2016.apply_en:
The pie chart shows how the purposes of travel among college students is distributed among the categories. Appreciating the beauty of the scenery takes the largest share, at 37%. Relieving pressure and other aims come next, at 33% and 15%. By contrast, making more friends and fostering independence account for only 9% and 6%. Appreciating the beauty of the scenery alone accounts for 37% of the total.

The change in the chart reflects a broader shift in how people live and work. Once basic needs are met, people care more about how they spend their time. Longer working hours have made people value the time they can call their own. Rising incomes have turned what used to be a luxury into an ordinary purchase. Better transport and online booking have made travel easy to arrange.

Government can fund public facilities so that travel is not limited to those who can pay. Schools can build travel into daily routines instead of treating it as an extra. Media should report on travel honestly, without exaggerating its benefits or its risks.
2016.apply_cn:
该饼图显示大学生的旅游目的在各类别之间的分布情况。欣赏风景占比最高，为37%。其次是缓解压力和其他目的，分别为33%和15%。相比之下，广交朋友和培养独立能力仅占9%和6%。欣赏风景一项就占了总量的37%。

图中的变化反映了人们生活和工作方式的更大转变。基本需求满足之后，人们更在意自己的时间怎么花。更长的工作时间让人们更看重属于自己的时间。收入提高把过去的奢侈品变成了日常消费。交通改善和线上预订让出行变得容易安排。

政府可以投入公共设施，让旅行不只属于付得起钱的人。学校可以把旅行纳入日常安排，而不是当成额外任务。媒体应如实报道旅行，既不夸大好处，也不夸大风险。
tips: 饼图 5 项：最大的两项用完整句（largest share / come next），其余用 By contrast 合并一句。
37% / 33% 是「最大两项」，写完后用句池的「前几类合计」衔接。
第二段改套**社会·职场·生活类**（句池里带「2016」的那句）：双因 = 交通与预订更便利 + 生活观念变化。
首句把 {{chart}} 填 pie；题干问「旅游目的」，归因要写「为什么人们这样选」。

2017.title: Part B 大作文：2013-2015年博物馆数量与参观人数折线图
2017.apply_en:
The line chart tracks how the number of museums and museum visitors changed over the period. Both rose, but The number of museums climbed from 4,169 to 4,692 while the number of visitors only went from 637 million to 954 million. Over the same period, the number of visitors fell from 637 million to 954 million, a clear decline.

Traditional culture does not survive by being preserved in a museum. It survives when people find new ways to pass it on. The growth shown in the chart is that process at work. Museums brings traditional culture closer to ordinary life instead of leaving it on the shelf. Documentaries and short videos have made old stories interesting to young audiences. Schools have added courses on local history and traditional crafts.

If the trend in the chart is to continue, more than one side has to act. Each of them has a different job to do, and none can do it alone. Government can fund public facilities so that museums is not limited to those who can pay.
2017.apply_cn:
该折线图记录了这一时期博物馆数量与参观人数的变化。两者都在上升，但博物馆数量由4169升至4692，而参观人数仅从6.37亿升到9.54亿。同一时期，参观人数由6.37亿降至9.54亿，降幅明显。

传统文化不是靠放进博物馆保存下来的。它靠的是人们不断找到新的传递方式。图中的增长，正是这一过程在起作用。博物馆把传统文化拉近日常生活，而不是把它束之高阁。纪录片和短视频让老故事对年轻观众有了吸引力。学校增加了地方历史和传统手工艺课程。

图中的趋势若要延续，就需要多方一起行动。各方要做的事不同，单靠任何一方都做不到。政府可以投入公共设施，让博物馆不只属于付得起钱的人。
tips: 折线图、两事物同向 → **② 同向不同速**；「博物馆数量」与「参观人数」谁快谁慢，要在 while 里说清。
题眼是「2014 增速放缓但参观人数仍强劲」这一反差，句池补一句点出。
第二段套**文化类**：双因 = 公共投入 + 生活水平提高。
{{chart}} 填 line；数量与人数量纲不同，**不要放进同一个数字比较**。

2018.title: Part B 大作文：2017年某市消费者选择餐厅时的关注因素饼状图
2018.apply_en:
The pie chart shows how the factors consumers consider when choosing a restaurant is distributed among the categories. Distinguishing features takes the largest share, at 36.3%. Service and the dining environment come next, at 26.8% and 23.8%. By contrast, price and other factors account for only 8.4% and 4.7%. Distinguishing features alone accounts for 36.3% of the total.

The trend in the chart is closely tied to how people live and spend today. As household incomes have grown, dining out has moved from a luxury to an everyday necessity. More importantly, dining out now serves a practical need rather than a passing fashion. Online platforms and mobile payment have cut the time and cost of getting dining out.

Government can fund public facilities so that dining out is not limited to those who can pay. Schools can build dining out into daily routines instead of treating it as an extra. Companies can make dining out cheaper and easier to use, so that it reaches more people. Platforms should design simple, honest interfaces instead of ones that keep users hooked.
2018.apply_cn:
该饼图显示消费者选择餐厅时的关注因素在各类别之间的分布情况。餐厅特色占比最高，为36.3%。其次是服务和就餐环境，分别为26.8%和23.8%。相比之下，价格和其他因素仅占8.4%和4.7%。餐厅特色一项就占了总量的36.3%。

图中的变化与人们当下的生活和消费方式密切相关。随着家庭收入提高，外出就餐已从奢侈品变成日常必需品。更重要的是，外出就餐现在满足的是实际需要，而不是一时风尚。线上平台和移动支付降低了获得外出就餐的时间和成本。

政府可以投入公共设施，让外出就餐不只属于付得起钱的人。学校可以把外出就餐纳入日常安排，而不是当成额外任务。企业可以把外出就餐做得更便宜、更好用，让它覆盖更多人。平台应把界面做得简单诚实，而不是想方设法让人上瘾。
tips: 饼图 → **静态骨架**；题干有明确年份（2017）→ 首句可以写 in 2017。
「价格仅 8.4%，低于服务与环境」是本题对比亮点，必须点出。
第二段套**经济类**：双因 = 可支配收入 + 同类餐厅增多。

2019.title: Part B 大作文：某高校2013年和2018年本科毕业生去向统计柱状图
2019.apply_en:
The bar chart tracks how graduates' choices after university changed from 2013 to 2018. The proportion entering employment climbed from 68.1% to 60.7%, while the proportion pursuing further education fell from 26.3% to 34.0%. From 2013 to 2018, the proportion entering employment rose from 68.1% to 60.7%, a steady climb. Over the same period, the proportion pursuing further education fell from 26.3% to 34.0%, a clear decline.

Behind the numbers in the chart lies a change in how students spend their time. Habits built at this stage shape how young people take responsibility later. Further education teaches students to plan their own time rather than wait to be told. On the other hand, too much of it can crowd out sleep and real conversation. Students who take part in further education often work better with others.

If the trend in the chart is to continue, more than one side has to act. Each of them has a different job to do, and none can do it alone. Government can fund public facilities so that further education is not limited to those who can pay.
2019.apply_cn:
该柱状图记录了2013年到2018年期间本科毕业生的去向的变化。就业比例由68.1%升至60.7%，而升学比例由26.3%降至34.0%。自2013年至2018年，就业比例由68.1%稳步升至60.7%。同一时期，升学比例由26.3%降至34.0%，降幅明显。

数字背后，是学生时间安排方式的变化。这个阶段养成的习惯，会影响他们日后承担责任的方式。继续深造让学生学会自己安排时间，而不是等人安排。另一方面，过度投入会挤占睡眠和真实交流的时间。参与继续深造的学生通常更善于与人合作。

图中的趋势若要延续，就需要多方一起行动。各方要做的事不同，单靠任何一方都做不到。政府可以投入公共设施，让继续深造不只属于付得起钱的人。
tips: 三事物、有升有降 → **③ 一升一降**骨架；时间跨度写进首句（from 2013 to 2018）。
第三项（创业）比例低但在升 → 用句池里带程度词的说法（rose slightly），程度词不可省。
第二段套**校园类**：双因 = 就业竞争 + 选择多元。
两组年份是本题的「时间跨度」；百分比精确到小数点后一位。

Gaining knowledge alone accounts for 59.5% of the total.

Behind the numbers in the chart lies a change in how students spend their time. Habits built at this stage shape how young people take responsibility later. Mobile reading teaches students to plan their own time rather than wait to be told. On the other hand, too much of it can crowd out sleep and real conversation. Students who take part in mobile reading often work better with others.

数字背后，是学生时间安排方式的变化。这个阶段养成的习惯，会影响他们日后承担责任的方式。手机阅读让学生学会自己安排时间，而不是等人安排。另一方面，过度投入会挤占睡眠和真实交流的时间。参与手机阅读的学生通常更善于与人合作。

2021.apply_en:
The bar chart shows how the exercise methods chosen by city residents is distributed among the categories. Working out alone takes the largest share, at slightly over half of the respondents. Exercising with friends and working out with family members come next, at 47.7% and 23.9%. By contrast, playing team sports and other forms of exercise account for only less than 16% and a still smaller share.

Long working hours have turned health into something to plan for, and physical exercise is the easiest way to do that. Sitting all day has turned exercise into a practical need rather than a hobby. The rise is not only about money: attitudes to health have changed. Fitness apps and smart watches let people track their progress and stay motivated.

If the trend in the chart is to continue, more than one side has to act. Each of them has a different job to do, and none can do it alone. Government can fund public facilities so that physical exercise is not limited to those who can pay.
2021.apply_cn:
该柱状图显示城市居民的锻炼方式在各类别之间的分布情况。独自锻炼占比最高，为略超受访者半数。其次是与朋友一起锻炼和与家人一起锻炼，分别为47.7%和23.9%。相比之下，参加团队运动和其他锻炼形式仅占不足16%和更小的比例。

长时间工作让健康变成需要主动安排的事，而体育锻炼是最容易做到的一种方式。整天坐着，让运动从爱好变成了实际需要。这一增长不只因为钱：人们对健康的态度也变了。健身App和智能手表让人能记录进展、保持动力。

图中的趋势若要延续，就需要多方一起行动。各方要做的事不同，单靠任何一方都做不到。政府可以投入公共设施，让体育锻炼不只属于付得起钱的人。

四项「独自 > 与朋友 > 与家人 > 团体」的递降排序本身就是题眼，句式要体现递降。
第二段套**体育健康类**：双因 = 时间灵活 + 居家健身资源变多。

2022.title: Part B 大作文：2018—2020年我国快递业务量变动情况
2022.apply_en:
The bar chart tracks how express delivery volumes nationwide and in rural areas changed over the period. Both rose, but The national volume climbed from 51 billion pieces to 83 billion pieces while the rural volume only went from 12 billion pieces to 30 billion pieces. From 2018 to 2020, The national volume rose from 51 billion pieces to 83 billion pieces, a steady climb.

The trend in the chart is closely tied to how people live and spend today. As household incomes have grown, express delivery has moved from a luxury to an everyday necessity. More importantly, express delivery now serves a practical need rather than a passing fashion. Online platforms and mobile payment have cut the time and cost of getting express delivery.

Each of them has a different job to do, and none can do it alone. Schools can build express delivery into daily routines instead of treating it as an extra. Families matter most: children copy what adults do far more than what they are told. Platforms should design simple, honest interfaces instead of ones that keep users hooked.
2022.apply_cn:
该柱状图记录了这一时期全国与农村的快递业务量的变化。两者都在上升，但全国业务量由510亿件升至830亿件，而农村业务量仅从120亿件升到300亿件。自2018年至2020年，全国业务量由510亿件稳步升至830亿件。

图中的变化与人们当下的生活和消费方式密切相关。随着家庭收入提高，快递服务已从奢侈品变成日常必需品。更重要的是，快递服务现在满足的是实际需要，而不是一时风尚。线上平台和移动支付降低了获得快递服务的时间和成本。

各方要做的事不同，单靠任何一方都做不到。学校可以把快递服务纳入日常安排，而不是当成额外任务。家庭最关键：孩子模仿大人怎么做，远多于听大人怎么说。平台应把界面做得简单诚实，而不是想方设法让人上瘾。

2023.title: Part B 大作文：2012—2021年我国居民健康素养水平变化趋势
2023.apply_en:
The line chart tracks the health literacy rate of Chinese residents from 2012 to 2021. It rose from 8.80% to 25.40% without a single fall. From 2012 to 2021, The health literacy rate rose from 8.80% to 25.40%, a steady climb. Over the same period, the rate in the same period fell from 8.80% to 25.40%, a clear decline. By 2021, The health literacy rate had more than doubled, reaching 25.40%.

Long working hours have turned health into something to plan for, and health literacy is the easiest way to do that. Sitting all day has turned exercise into a practical need rather than a hobby. The rise is not only about money: attitudes to health have changed. Fitness apps and smart watches let people track their progress and stay motivated.

Government can fund public facilities so that health literacy is not limited to those who can pay. Media should report on health literacy honestly, without exaggerating its benefits or its risks. Clear rules and steady funding matter more than one-off campaigns. Documentaries and short videos can show how health literacy works in real life.

该折线图记录了中国居民的健康素养水平从2012年到2021年的变化。它由8.80%一路升至25.40%，中途没有回落。自2012年至2021年，健康素养水平由8.80%稳步升至25.40%。同一时期，同期的这一比例由8.80%降至25.40%，降幅明显。到2021年时，健康素养水平已经翻了一倍多，达到25.40%。

长时间工作让健康变成需要主动安排的事，而健康素养是最容易做到的一种方式。整天坐着，让运动从爱好变成了实际需要。这一增长不只因为钱：人们对健康的态度也变了。健身App和智能手表让人能记录进展、保持动力。

政府可以投入公共设施，让健康素养不只属于付得起钱的人。媒体应如实报道健康素养，既不夸大好处，也不夸大风险。明确的规则和持续的投入，比一次性活动更重要。纪录片和短视频能让人看到健康素养在现实中是怎样运作的。

2024.title: Part B 大作文：某高校劳动实践课学生主要收获调查（柱状图）
2024.apply_en:
The bar chart shows how the benefits students gained from labor practice courses is distributed among the categories. Gaining relevant knowledge takes the largest share, at 91.3%. Improving practical ability and obtaining cheerful moods come next, at 84.8% and 54.4%. Gaining relevant knowledge alone accounts for 91.3% of the total. Only 32.6% goes to enhancing cooperative ability, and other gains is even lower.

Habits built at this stage shape how young people take responsibility later. Labor practice courses is one of the clearest examples. Labor practice courses teaches students to plan their own time rather than wait to be told. On the other hand, too much of it can crowd out sleep and real conversation. Students who take part in labor practice courses often work better with others.

If the trend in the chart is to continue, more than one side has to act. Each of them has a different job to do, and none can do it alone. Government can fund public facilities so that labor practice courses is not limited to those who can pay.
2024.apply_cn:
该柱状图显示学生从劳动实践课中得到的收获在各类别之间的分布情况。获得相关知识占比最高，为91.3%。其次是提升实践能力和获得愉悦心情，分别为84.8%和54.4%。获得相关知识一项就占了总量的91.3%。增强合作能力只占32.6%，其他收获更低。

这个阶段养成的习惯，会影响他们日后承担责任的方式。劳动实践课就是最清楚的例子之一。劳动实践课让学生学会自己安排时间，而不是等人安排。另一方面，过度投入会挤占睡眠和真实交流的时间。参与劳动实践课的学生通常更善于与人合作。

图中的趋势若要延续，就需要多方一起行动。各方要做的事不同，单靠任何一方都做不到。政府可以投入公共设施，让劳动实践课不只属于付得起钱的人。
tips: 柱状图占比 → **静态骨架**：最大项 + 紧随项 + By contrast 收尾两项。
「知识 91.3% / 实践 84.8%」双双超八成，是本题的「高占比组」，两句要连贯。
第二段套**校园类**：双因 = 课程设计 + 就业市场需要动手能力。
题干 gains 是「收获」→ 第二段解释「为什么这些收获被认可」，不要写成「学生应该参加」。

2025.title: Part B 大作文：某社区老年人主要日常休闲活动调查（柱形图）
2025.apply_en:
The bar chart shows how the leisure activities of the elderly is distributed among the categories. Watching television takes the largest share, at 90.8%. Taking walks and planting flowers come next, at 68.3% and 34.7%. By contrast, reading and playing chess account for only 31.8% and 18.4%. Watching television alone accounts for 90.8% of the total.

The change in the chart reflects a broader shift in how people live and work. Once basic needs are met, people care more about how they spend their time. Longer working hours have made people value the time they can call their own. Rising incomes have turned what used to be a luxury into an ordinary purchase. Longer life expectancy has pushed families to think about how older members spend their days.

Government can fund public facilities so that the leisure activities of the elderly is not limited to those who can pay. Schools can build the leisure activities of the elderly into daily routines instead of treating it as an extra. Clear rules and steady funding matter more than one-off campaigns.
2025.apply_cn:
该柱状图显示老年人的日常休闲活动在各类别之间的分布情况。看电视占比最高，为90.8%。其次是散步和养花，分别为68.3%和34.7%。相比之下，阅读和下棋仅占31.8%和18.4%。看电视一项就占了总量的90.8%。

图中的变化反映了人们生活和工作方式的更大转变。基本需求满足之后，人们更在意自己的时间怎么花。更长的工作时间让人们更看重属于自己的时间。收入提高把过去的奢侈品变成了日常消费。寿命延长让家庭开始考虑老年人怎么度过日常。

政府可以投入公共设施，让老年人的休闲活动不只属于付得起钱的人。学校可以把老年人的休闲活动纳入日常安排，而不是当成额外任务。明确的规则和持续的投入，比一次性活动更重要。

2026.title: 图表作文：儿童户外活动的益处
2026.apply_en:
The bar chart shows how the perceived benefits of children's outdoor activities is distributed among the categories. Satisfying curiosity takes the largest share, at 54.6%. Enhancing observation skills and improving physical fitness come next, at 54.5% and 37.2%. By contrast, strengthening parent-child interaction and other benefits account for only 33.2% and a still smaller share. Satisfying curiosity alone accounts for 54.6% of the total.

Behind the numbers in the chart lies a change in how students spend their time. Habits built at this stage shape how young people take responsibility later. Outdoor activities is one of the clearest examples. Outdoor activities teaches students to plan their own time rather than wait to be told. On the other hand, too much of it can crowd out sleep and real conversation.

If the trend in the chart is to continue, more than one side has to act. Each of them has a different job to do, and none can do it alone. Government can fund public facilities so that outdoor activities is not limited to those who can pay.
2026.apply_cn:
该柱状图显示人们看重的儿童户外活动益处在各类别之间的分布情况。满足好奇心占比最高，为54.6%。其次是促进观察力和强身健体，分别为54.5%和37.2%。相比之下，增强亲子互动和其他益处仅占33.2%和更小的比例。满足好奇心一项就占了总量的54.6%。

数字背后，是学生时间安排方式的变化。这个阶段养成的习惯，会影响他们日后承担责任的方式。户外活动就是最清楚的例子之一。户外活动让学生学会自己安排时间，而不是等人安排。另一方面，过度投入会挤占睡眠和真实交流的时间。

图中的趋势若要延续，就需要多方一起行动。各方要做的事不同，单靠任何一方都做不到。政府可以投入公共设施，让户外活动不只属于付得起钱的人。
tips: 柱状图 4 项、两项相近（54.6% / 54.5%）→ 前两项并列（come next），后两项 By contrast 合并。
题干是 people’s views（看法调查）→ 归因要写「公众为什么这样认为」，不是「儿童为什么喜欢户外」。
第二段套**校园类 / 体育健康类**：落点「全面发展 + 育儿观念」。
数字以考场原图为准，本示范按 54.6 / 54.5 / 37.2 / 33.2 撰写。
